sources.label: Bloxodes — Anime Card Farm mutations guide
Roblox — official Anime Card Farm experience

item.name: Starfallen
item.howToGet: Buy a Starfallen mutated pack when it appears after using Spawn Pack, then place the pack on your plot to open it.
item.effect: Guide-reported 75x multiplier to both the card's sale value and passive earning rate.
